projects.title: Chick-fil-A - Ground-Up Carpentry and Interior Buildout
projects.description: Reliant Renovations completed the comprehensive carpentry and interior-finish package for the ground-up construction of a new restaurant, carrying its scope from initial wood framing through completed interior finishes.
scope: Complete wood stick framing
Installation of structural roof trusses and roof framing
Framing of all interior partitions and soffits
Drywall installation, taping, spackling and finishing
Interior painting
Suspended ceiling-grid installation
Wall wainscoting and stainless-steel trim
Interior door installation
Coordination with the project team and other trades

projects.title: Lidl Staten Island - Masonry and Exterior Restoration
projects.description: Reliant Renovations completed masonry, exterior EIFS repair and concrete-floor finishing work at an existing retail location, including extensive interior and exterior repairs.
scope: Project masonry scope
Exterior EIFS facade repairs and restoration
Numerous interior masonry repairs
Masonry work and repairs within the elevator shaft
Grinding and sealing of basement and cellar concrete floors
Coordination of multiple interior and exterior scopes

Exterior metal-panel installation

Associated exterior trim and finish work

projects.title: Harbor Freight - Interior and Exterior Retail Refresh
projects.description: Reliant Renovations completed a comprehensive interior and exterior refresh of an operating retail location. The work was phased and performed during off-hours to minimize disruption to store operations.
scope: Repainting of the entire retail interior
Construction of new interior partitions
Removal of designated exterior doors and infill with concrete masonry units
Preparation and repainting of the entire building exterior
Installation of new exterior bollards
Associated patching, preparation and finish work
Off-hours coordination around active store operations

projects.title: Lidl Harlem - Flooring and Selective Demolition
projects.description: Reliant Renovations completed a multi-phase demolition and polished-concrete flooring package within an existing supermarket. All work was performed during off-hours to accommodate store operations.
scope: Demolition and removal of existing first-floor flooring
Demolition and removal of existing cellar-level flooring
Selective demolition of interior partitions
Preparation of exposed concrete surfaces
Polished concrete flooring throughout the first floor and cellar
Off-hours coordination to minimize operational disruption
